item_name: Blue Sabre Pepper Spray USA Formula (hc22tcusbd)
item_short_desc: The Blue Sabre Pepper Spray offers maximum stopping power with a blue marking dye formula that lasts for 24 hours. Legal for sale in 50 States. NY, MA and HI require FFL for purchase.
description: The Blue Sabre Pepper Spray offers maximum stopping power with a blue marking dye formula that lasts for 24 hours. Complete with a clear hard case and quick release key ring for hands-free carry, the Sabre Red Pepper Spray has a maximum strength ballistic stream which reduces wind blow-back. With a range of 8 to 10 feet and containing approximately 25 shots, this is the ideal personal protection item. ISO 9001 Certified.
